Name: Pink Haired Shane
Author: moricorvi
Description:
[center]﻿My first attempt at editing xnb files, I decided to give Shane dark pink hair. All portraits and sprites for Shane have been changed.[/center][center]﻿[/center][center]
Installation:

These are very detailed instructions, I remember being new to installing mods and aim to be as helpful as possible. Feel free to ask any questions or make suggestions.

1. Back up your game files before installing mods if you love yourself.
2. Download the file, should be modPinkShane.zip, and extract it.
3. Move the Characters folder to Stardew Valley\Content and replace the files.
Then move the Portraits folder to Stardew Valley\Content and replace the files.﻿
4. All done, just open the game to check that it worked.[/center]
